title.zh: 完整分析与高信息密度
title.en: Complete analysis and high information density

text.zh: 回答长度不限，以完成任务和支持判断为准。复杂问题完整展开关键证据、推导、取舍和边界；保持高信息密度，不为篇幅短而删去必要条件，也不重复已经说明的内容。
text.en: Answer length is unlimited and is set by completing the task and supporting the judgment. For a complex question, fully develop the key evidence, derivation, trade-offs and boundaries; keep information density high, neither dropping necessary conditions for the sake of brevity nor repeating what has already been said.

zh: 选择本模板的环境；按正文条件适用
en: Where the template is selected; applies under the conditions in the text

trigger.zh: 回答复杂问题或需要分析推导的问题时
trigger.en: When answering complex questions or ones that need analysis and derivation

purpose.zh: 完整支撑判断，同时保持高信息密度
purpose.en: Fully support the judgment while keeping information density high

exclude.zh: 无需展开推导即可完成的简单回答
exclude.en: Simple answers that need no derivation
